module.name: Vanilla Commands
config.enabled.desc: When the server does not have the mod, read and write world data with /data, /setblock, /item and /gamerule. Needs operator permissions and the sendCommandFeedback game rule
name: Vanilla commands
error.timeout: The server did not answer the command. Make sure the sendCommandFeedback game rule is enabled
error.parse: Could not read the data the server sent: %s
error.other_dimension: Blocks in other dimensions can only be edited when the server has the mod
error.too_long: A value is too long to send with chat commands
error.item_too_long: This item has too much data to set with /item
error.illegal_characters: The data has characters that cannot be sent in chat, such as §
error.slot: This slot cannot be set with /item
error.player_data: Vanilla commands can only change a player's inventory. Install the mod on the server to edit other player data
